whatIs: HyperUI is a collection of copy-and-paste Tailwind CSS components. They're grouped into Application, Marketing, and Neobrutalism, with variants of accordions, cards, forms, charts, banners, and more, plus templates.
It's a good fit when you already use Tailwind and want to start from a ready-made block of HTML instead of writing it from scratch.
uses: Copying a contact or call-to-action section for a landing page.
Building a dashboard with cards, detail lists, and charts already laid out.
Trying a neobrutalist style on buttons and cards without creating the design yourself.
caveats: These are markup snippets, not framework components: you add the interactivity yourself.
You copy the code into your project, so you don't get automatic updates.
Check that the classes match the version of Tailwind you use.
pricingNote: Open source under the MIT license.
idealFor: Tailwind projects that need interface blocks to copy.
